d: Tekkers is a youth football academy in Bahrain and Saudi Arabia, and an Official Arsenal Football Development Partner. Our coaches work to the Arsenal Football Development methodology, and children's safety comes first in everything we do.
Coach children in our Bahrain sessions on the days and times we agree with you.
Plan and deliver sessions to the Arsenal Football Development methodology, alongside our existing coaches.
q: A recognised coaching licence: UEFA C, AFC C, FA Level 2 or equivalent.
Fluent English. Arabic is a plus.
The right to work in Bahrain for this part-time role.

Everyone who works with us, employed or freelance, is checked before they work with children: identity check, two references, a safeguarding interview, a criminal record (good conduct) certificate, qualifications checked, first aid and safeguarding training with our induction, and a signed code of conduct. You will not work with children until every check is complete, and in your first weeks you will always work alongside another checked adult.
x: Please apply only through the form on our careers page: tekkersfootball.com/careers. We do not review applications sent through LinkedIn. Add your CV and your certificates, and a short video introduction if you like. We review applications, hold an online interview and a practical assessment, check references and then make an offer.
